title: Operating Lines of Credit Booking Fees: Origination and UCC Filing
content:
When a line of the Operating Lines of Credit is booked, an origination fee and, where a new financing statement is filed, a UCC filing fee are assessed on the booking date.

## Rules

1. **Origination fee.** When a line is booked, an origination fee of the product's origination fee percentage of the commitment, but not less than the product's minimum origination fee, rounded to cents, is assessed on the booking date. A product whose origination percentage and minimum are both zero books no origination fee charge.
2. **UCC filing fee.** The product's UCC filing fee is passed through as its own fee charge on the booking date only when a new financing statement had to be filed, that is when the member held no other operating line in active, suspended or matured status on the booking date; an existing financing statement already covers the member's crops, livestock and farm products.
3. **Once only.** Neither fee is charged again at renewal, and neither is refunded if the line is later closed.

The origination fee is the higher of the minimum origination fee and the commitment multiplied by the origination fee percentage rounded to cents.

## Worked cases (hypothetical Revolving Operating Line, 0.25% with a USD 350 minimum)

| Commitment | Percentage of the commitment | Origination fee |
|---|---|---|
| USD 100,000 | USD 250.00 | USD 350.00 — the minimum is higher |
| USD 140,000 | USD 350.00 | USD 350.00 — the two are equal |
| USD 200,000 | USD 500.00 | USD 500.00 |

## UCC filing fee judgement

| Other operating line of the member in active, suspended or matured status on the booking date | UCC filing fee charged |
|---|---|
| None | Yes |
| One or more | No — the existing financing statement already covers the collateral |

A StartRight Operating Line, whose origination percentage and minimum are both zero, carries no origination fee charge at booking; its UCC filing fee is still charged where no other operating line is held.
